name: context-bar-compact
description: One-line context bar above the prompt: usage by /context category, 5h/7d limits and room before compaction; /context-bar details for a full breakdown. Compact fork of akash001uts/context-bar (MIT).

warn_at.title: Warn from, % of the window
warn_at.description: The figure turns yellow from this share of the context window.

alert_at.title: Past the working zone from, % of the window
alert_at.description: From this share the figure turns red, a toast says so once, and a row offers a handoff or /compact.
